title: Design System: Edgar Bonilla G. — Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero h1 and chapter openers. Uppercase, set so tight the lines nearly touch — the block reads as a mass, not as sentences.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the About lead. The Work heading runs larger still at clamp(56px, 7.6vw, 144px).

title.purpose: Project titles and expertise area names.

body.purpose: Narrative paragraphs and project descriptions. Measure capped tightly — the Work intro holds at 36ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata keys, navigation, status lines, button text. The system's connective tissue; appears more often than any other role.

fontLoadingDefect.detail: Syne and Inter are the intended faces but no next/font import exists in the project. app/globals.css:7-8 defines --font-syne as "Arial Black", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial and --font-inter as "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial. The site renders in system fonts under variable names that promise otherwise. Tracking and weight values are tuned against fallback metrics and will need re-tuning once the real faces load.

shadows.name: print-lift
shadows.purpose: Inset detail frame in the light Work register only. Sells case-study media as a physical print on paper.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Scroll-progress and active-state indicators. Emissive, not elevational.

shadows.name: interior-warm
shadows.purpose: Inset warmth inside the About ribbon field. Reads as light in a room, not a raised surface.

shadows.name: interior-amber
shadows.purpose: Second-stage amber depth in the About ribbon sequence.

shadows.name: focus-ring-accent
shadows.purpose: Focus and status ring on circular metadata objects.

shadows.name: focus-ring-graphite
shadows.purpose: Separator ring punching a marker out of its ground.

motion.name: ease-primary
motion.purpose: System default for state changes and reveals. The dominant easing in the codebase.

motion.name: gsap-entrance
motion.purpose: Dominant GSAP ease for copy beats and staggered entrances.

motion.name: gsap-orchestrated
motion.purpose: Intro seam split and menu overlay reveal.

motion.name: gsap-scrub
motion.purpose: Scroll-linked scrubbing — frame sequence and progress. Linear by definition; easing a scrub breaks the scroll contract.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Interactive state change (hover, focus). The dominant duration.

motion.name: duration-component
motion.purpose: Component-level transitions such as the arrow button glyph swap.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The hero's primary destination action. Square, orange, uppercase; inverts to white on hover and lifts 2px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 152px; padding: 0 17px; border: none; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #050505); background: var(--brand, #ff4f18); font-family: var(--font-inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 220ms ease, background 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: var(--brand, #ff4f18); background: var(--white, #ffffff); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #ff4f18); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent companion action with a single bottom hairline. Same lift as primary; only the color logic differs.

components.name: Arrow Button
components.description: The signature action. Square, heavy uppercase, with a northeast-arrow glyph that translates away and back on hover.
components.html: LET'S WORK TOGETHER

components.name: Section Label
components.description: The system's connective tissue: uppercase eyebrow with positive tracking and an orange index numeral.

components.name: Display Heading
components.description: The display voice: uppercase, aggressive negative tracking, lines set so tight the block reads as a mass. Accent word in orange.
components.css: .ds-display { margin: 0; color: var(--white, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-syne, 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(56px, 7.6vw, 144px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.84; letter-spacing: -0.065em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-display__accent { display: block; color: var(--brand, #ff4f18); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Menu overlay link: oversized display type with an orange index and square marker. Active state takes a larger orange marker and orange type.
components.html: 01Home02About
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: var(--ink, #050505); padding: 16px; } .ds-nav__link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; color: var(--white, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-syne, 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(34px, 6.2vw, 52px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms ease; } .ds-nav__marker { width: 9px; height: 9px; background: var(--white, #ffffff); transition: background 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-nav__index { color: var(--brand, #ff4f18); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: var(--brand, #ff4f18); } .ds-nav__link--active { color: var(--brand, #ff4f18); } .ds-nav__link--active .ds-nav__marker { background: var(--brand, #ff4f18); transform: scale(1.5); } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #ff4f18); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Media Frame
components.description: The light register's only rounded, shadowed surface. Presents case-study media as a physical print on paper. Not a card — there is no card primitive in this system.
components.css: .ds-media { position: relative; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 28px; background: #111516; box-shadow: 0 26px 60px rgba(4, 14, 18, 0.3); } .ds-media__fill { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0c3542, #111516 60%, #ef5a2f); } .ds-media__caption { position: absolute; left: 20px; bottom: 16px; margin: 0; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78); font-family: var(--font-inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Hairline Divider
components.description: The only divider treatment on the dark register. Borders in this system are always hairlines, never heavy strokes.
components.css: .ds-divider-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted, #a3a3a3); font-family: var(--font-inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-hairline { width: 100%; height: 0; margin: 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24); }

narrative.overview:
Every surface behaves like an optical instrument resolving focus. The site opens as a solid orange field that splits along a horizontal seam like a shutter; the hero scrubs a 195-frame portrait sequence from obstruction into clarity; the About portrait reveals its monochrome layer through a liquid aperture that follows the pointer. Nothing here is decoration borrowed from a template — the entire visual argument is a lens finding its subject, and the subject is the designer's own judgment.

The system is dark, dense, and type-led. Near-black is the ground state, oversized uppercase display type is the structure, and a single kinetic orange carries every moment of movement and intent. Interactive surfaces are square-cornered and flat; depth arrives through tonal layering, film grain, blur, and real photography rather than through drop shadows. The result reads as a screening room rather than a product page: quiet material, loud typography, and motion that means something.

The system runs in two registers. The dark register (intro, hero, About, Contact) is the default: near-black ground, hard edges, orange accent, atmospheric depth. The light register (the Work chapter) inverts to warm paper with graphite ink, and is the one place where rounded media frames and real drop shadows are sanctioned — the case studies present as physical prints laid on a table. Treat the switch as a deliberate chapter break, not as drift.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#050505) with a single accent — no secondary or tertiary palette
Oversized uppercase display type with hard negative tracking (down to -0.065em)
Square corners on everything interactive; radius is reserved for media and metadata
Scroll is the primary interaction verb; motion is choreographed, never ambient
Film grain and tonal layering instead of elevation
Every animated surface ships a genuine reduced-motion path

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent in this system. When a new state needs distinction, reach for weight, scale, case, or tonal value — never for a second hue. Per-project accents are scoped to their story block and are not exceptions to this.

rules.name: The Vibration Rule
rules.body: #ff4f18 on #f2efe8 vibrates at body sizes. On the light register, orange is permitted for large display type and fills, but running text uses Ember Deep (#9d3d21) instead.

rules.name: The Single H1 Rule
rules.body: The portfolio hero owns the page's only h1. Every chapter below opens at h2. This is an accessibility invariant, not a preference.

rules.name: The Tracking Inversion Rule
rules.body: Display type tracks negative (-0.045em to -0.065em); label type tracks positive (0.1em to 0.15em). The two never meet in the middle — a heading at neutral tracking is a defect in this system.

rules.name: The Uppercase Structure Rule
rules.body: Uppercase carries structure (display, labels, navigation, buttons). Sentence case carries reading (body paragraphs). Never uppercase a paragraph and never sentence-case a label.

rules.name: The Anchored Action Rule
rules.body: Hero destination actions sit outside the copy-beat timeline. They stay anchored and interactive for the full pinned sequence — the visitor can act at any scroll position without waiting for a beat to finish.

rules.name: The Scan Path Rule
rules.body: Identity, role, domains, and location remain readable without interaction at every breakpoint. No motion, hover, or scroll state may be the only way to reach them.

rules.name: The Flat-Interactive Rule
rules.body: Buttons, links, chips, and navigation never carry a drop shadow in either register. If an element needs to feel raised, it is the wrong element.

rules.name: The Light-Register Exception
rules.body: Drop shadows exist only in the Work chapter, only on media frames, and only to sell physicality. Introducing one in the dark register is drift.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: If it can be clicked, its corners are square. A rounded button is not this system.

rules.name: The Radius Is Content Rule
rules.body: Radius marks something as either an image or a piece of metadata. It never marks something as an action.

dos: Do keep border-radius: 0 on every interactive element. Square corners are the form signature.
Do use exactly one accent. Distinguish new states with weight, scale, case, or tonal value.
Do track display type negative (-0.045em to -0.065em) and label type positive (0.1em to 0.15em).
Do build depth from tonal layering, grain, blur, and real imagery.
Do ship a genuine prefers-reduced-motion path with every animated surface — a static composition that still communicates, not a stripped one.
Do keep the hero's h1 the page's only h1.
Do switch to Ember Deep (#9d3d21) for orange running text on the light register.
Do scope per-project accents to their story block.
Do let display type grow proportionally larger as the viewport narrows.
donts: Don't introduce a rounded button, a card component, or a card grid. PRODUCT.md names card-heavy template grids as an anti-reference, and the absence of a card primitive is what keeps the chapters full-bleed and cinematic.
Don't add a drop shadow to the dark register, or to any interactive element in either register.
Don't add a second accent hue, a gradient on text, or a gradient as a surface treatment.
Don't add a second WebGL context. Three.js is dynamically imported and hero-only; the About reveal stays on Canvas 2D.
Don't introduce Tailwind or a utility-class layer — the system is hand-authored CSS with custom properties.
Don't let motion run without narrative purpose. Ambient, looping, or decorative animation is drift.
Don't put #ff4f18 in running text on #f2efe8.
Don't neutralize display tracking. A heading at letter-spacing: normal is a defect here.
Don't let a planned-but-unbuilt destination behave like a working page.
